prompts.title: Fix scroll reset
prompts.content: Whenever finishin to add information in a input field. I click outside of it to access another field, but since there are a lot of tasks, the scrollview reset back to the top, hidding the element I tried to interact next. Implement the fix to prevent this scroll reset back to the top and keep the container/scrollview in the same position.
